description: M0 public API — sole interface for all callers. Frozen as of Phase 1. All communication with M0 must go through this schema only. No Rust type sharing across boundaries.

HealthResponse.description: Response from GET /health — M0 health status and all 7 criteria

status.description: ok = all 7 criteria pass; degraded = one or more fail

criteria.description: Per-criterion health status (optional — included when status=degraded)

ProxyRequest.description: Inbound proxy request routed through Caddy at 127.0.0.1:7400

path.description: Request path (must match a declared Caddy route)

AuditEntry.description: A single audit log entry (NDJSON line in m0-audit-YYYYMMDD.ndjson)

event_type.description: One of the 7 canonical M0 event types

metadata.description: Structured metadata — path + digest for assets, never content

PolicyViolationResponse.description: Response when a request is blocked by M0 policy
